description: SaurKshetra version 5 is a public Mendeley Data release of monthly environmental variables and solar-site suitability outputs for 371 locations across India. The article states that source climate values came from NASA POWER at a one-degree grid for January 2013 through December 2022. Variables include global and clear-sky irradiance, albedo, cloud amount, near-surface temperature, dew point and precipitation. The repository lists an Excel dataset and a machine-learning notebook under CC BY 4.0. The researchers group locations into five Indian regions and classify suitability using weighted scores, clustering and a random forest. Coverage is sampled grid locations and monthly summaries, not measured power output from 371 farms or a site-level interconnection study. Grid resolution, variable weights and classification choices limit direct construction decisions. A reviewer-assessed simulation use is ranking candidate PV deployment areas before more detailed capacity planning. data-jrc-pvgis-photovoltaic-geographical-information-system is a related solar resource service with different methods. A rejected candidate represented an earlier one-year version of this deposit; the current ten-year release is a reusable input collection. No spreadsheet or notebook was downloaded or run. A known limitation is that the ranking depends on the authors’ weighting and training choices.
